description: Predicate 4c UNSAT — market structurally dominated. Three paid-channel options (linkedin_30k, google_30k, content_30k) with base CACs 80/75/70. Competitor counter-impact is heavy across the board (15-40 per competitor per response), so even content_30k's best case (70 + 15 + 12 = 97) exceeds target_cac=85. No move keeps CAC under the LTV ceiling. Solver must return UNSAT, surfacing that the market structure itself is the problem — not the channel choice. Mirrors channel-score-3 / content-calendar-3 negative-test pattern.
_unsat_note: Even the best move (content_30k, base 70) lifts to at least 70 + 15 + 12 = 97 under the lightest competitor response combo — still over 85. LinkedIn and Google are far worse. Every (move, response_combo) pair violates the CAC ceiling, so the solver correctly reports UNSAT. Strategic implication: the market is structurally dominated; no paid-channel move survives. Negative test mirrors content-calendar-3 / channel-score-3.
